episode.intent: For all patients who are older than 55 years old, what is the percentage of female who has abnormal prothrombin time (PT)?
episode.failed_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN denom = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (num * 100.0) / denom END AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num,
    COUNT(*) AS denom
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 55
      AND l.PT >= 14
  ) AS sub
) AS t;

episode.intent: Which card costs more converted mana, "Serra Angel" or "Shrine Keeper"?
episode.failed_sql:
SELECT CASE
  WHEN COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(name) = 'Serra Angel' THEN convertedManaCost END), -1) >
       COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(name) = 'Shrine Keeper' THEN convertedManaCost END), -1)
    THEN 'Serra Angel'
  WHEN COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(name) = 'Shrine Keeper' THEN convertedManaCost END), -1) >
       COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(name) = 'Serra Angel' THEN convertedManaCost END), -1)
    THEN 'Shrine Keeper'
  ELSE 'Tie'
END AS more_expensive
FROM cards;
